scope: Review and corrections to the uncommitted task finding suppression feature

fixes.issue: Permissions revalidated before transaction could become stale while waiting for record locks; no asset store skipped permission checks.
fixes.fix: Trusted role passed independently of optional AssetStore; committing transaction serializes asset mutations and rechecks explicit assets, intent lineage, and running Worker state. Evidence copying does not hold the added asset/task locks.

fixes.issue: A rule query deadline was treated as a model failure and permitted registration; profile resolution conflated database failure and missing configuration.
fixes.fix: Infrastructure errors fail closed. Profile resolution uses request context and preserves query errors while sharing the provider cache/rate limiter. Pre/post review metadata reads have bounded database waits.

fixes.issue: Classifier always used streaming, ignoring non-streaming profile configuration.
fixes.fix: Select Stream/Complete from the resolved profile. Bound collected model text to 32 KiB; invalid/oversized model output is recorded as unchecked under the agreed policy.

fixes.issue: A missing/mismatched task context removed dynamic system feedback but left historical feedback tool bodies visible.
fixes.fix: Suppress historical feedback bodies on invalid trusted context, including deferred tool results; preserve original history and tool-call pairing.

fixes.issue: Distinct feedback pages accumulated without a historical body budget; database refresh ignored cancellation; empty tasks received redundant instructions.
fixes.fix: Keep at most 6000 Unicode characters of recent successful feedback read bodies, keep older calls as reread placeholders, refresh only retained IDs, propagate query context, omit empty-task feedback instruction and unnecessary final-page probe.

fixes.issue: A late revoke response could update a replaced task/drawer state.
fixes.fix: Scope-token checks discard late revoke completion/errors after task or drawer changes.

measurements.note: Synthetic fixture timings only, not production latency or token estimates. The historical body budget is separate from the 6000-character dynamic feedback page and from complete-request token limits.

limitations: Semantic accuracy/false-positive rate of live models was not benchmarked; models were simulated.
User-selected fail-open on model failure/uncertainty remains, with persisted unchecked receipts. Permission, database and cancellation errors remain fail-closed.
The drawer stale-response guard was type-checked; no additional live-browser interaction run was performed during this review.
